result.brief: 提出免训练的传感器运动对齐指标 S²，衡量模型感官表征与物理运动几何的一致性，用于离线预测具身策略成功率并解释 VLA 与世界动作模型表现。
result.reason: Proposes a training-free metric measuring alignment between sensory representations and motion geometry, extending the Platonic Representation Hypothesis to embodied models—a representation-level contribution.
